description: This is a C source file implementing a sample messaging application that can send, request, listen for messages, and perform discovery operations using RT messaging APIs. It includes functions for handling messages, performing discovery requests, and managing connection lifecycle, with command-line options to configure behavior.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line application.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a message; processes the message and sends a response if it's a request.

methods.name: discoverWildcardDestinations
methods.description: Performs a discovery request for wildcard destinations matching an expression.

methods.name: discoverObjectElements
methods.description: Performs a discovery request for object elements of a specified object.

methods.name: discoverElementObjects
methods.description: Performs a discovery request for element objects matching specified elements.

methods.name: discoverRegisteredComponents
methods.description: Performs a discovery request for registered components.
